There's a lot of logs there. Can you provide a date/time (to the minute, ideally) where you observed this, and whose avatar failed to load, along with the associated log.
I will note that we do not officially support Proton, so it is very possible that this is  due to that. I'd be interested in the logs from a Windows user.

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: I didn't catch the name of the avatars that didn't load, but it didn't seem to be an avatar-specific issue since this also happened in private worlds with friends using avatars I'd already seen before. It just seems like, at some point (15-20mins in, never right away), the bug kicks in and anything new after that point doesn't load. Also, it's kind of hard to tell exactly when the bug kicks in because you first notice it when someone doesn't load.

I know you don't support linux officially, I figured since some Windows-users are having similar problems you might get some new angle on the problem since the logs are still generated by VRChat (though run through proton).

@{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}: Somebody else has already nailed it better than I: https://github.com/ValveSoftware/Proton/issues/1199
Seems to be a problem with OVRLipsync causing a memory leak. The workaround seems to be either deleting OVRLipSync.dll (thereby loosing lipsync) or updating to proton experimental.
I don't know if this helps on the windows-side of things for those with similar problems, but it might be worth checking out as our problems are usually an exacerbated version of their problems.
EDIT: To be more specific: It _could_ very well be a proton-problem, but as I do not know how Valve has fixed it on their end, it is feasible that the fix on Linux is just a gamespecific workaround and not a remedy of the root cause. The error could very well be with OVRLipsync.dll itself, and so be present on Windows and simply not expressing itself that often for unrelated reasons (like some other unrelated process clearing vram intermittently preventing the error from happening in most cases).
EDIT 2: Here's a couple of bug reports from your bug tracker that seems to experience the same thing on Windows:

details:
I've had this recurring bug lately where everything seems peachy for about 20 minutes. Then, at some point, new people joining the world (or people changing into an uncached avatar) will only produce the blue diamond avatar and be stuck loading at 0%. When this happens, the world- and social-tab will not load any results and be empty. If I try to go to my home, the screen will fade to black and hang there unable to go any further/load.
It seems like, after some time, I loose connection to some particular VRChat-servers/services (those responsible for avatars, worlds and have assets fetched from them) while I don't loose connection to the services responsible for streaming movement and audio.
I've tried clearing the cache, and turning down/up all the graphics/safety-settings, but it doesn't seem to make a difference.
I'll admit I'm running this through Proton on Linux (Arch Linux on AMD Ryzen 5900x, Radeon 6800XT), but it seems like a lot of Windows-users are experiencing the same kind of bug, so perhaps my logs can shed some light on it from a different perspective.
Zip contains a bunch of logs gathered friday 19/11 where I experienced the problem a bunch of times: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1OCRU9lGpx_angLN2kmmmF3_L1cKVQOYP/view?usp=sharing
title: Avatars stop loading after awhile, worlds and social-tab becomes empty, changing world gets you stuck on loading-screen
